text:
Ava (Marketing): Draft for the launch post is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Focus: Redwood Optimize, short benchmark line, and an embeddings example + inbound routing. Need legal + sales by EOD Wed so we can publish Thu AM.

Diego (Content): Pasting tiny embedding snippet to include so engineers can copy: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-mini","input":"Summarize Redwood Optimize benefits"}'
```

Nina (Legal): Quick pass: remove hard numbers like "5x cheaper" unless cited. Change to "dramatically lower per-token cost with batching and caching". Also reword SLA lines to "where contracted". Approve after edits.

Sam (Sales): CTA routing: "Request a demo" -> HubSpot form hb-102 (AE queue); "Try Hosted API" -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (growth SDR); "See Optimize in action" -> webinar (Eventbrite -> HubSpot list). Flag webinar registrants as MQL if company_size > 50.

Ava (Marketing): Added CTA mapping in doc and ops playbook note: if registrant.company_size >50 AND role in ["Eng","Product","ML"] then tag high-priority and create AE task.

Diego (Content): Trimmed benchmark claim; caption: "Latency and per-token cost measured on supported model variants; results vary by workload." Removed word "public" per legal.

Ava (Marketing): OpsBot scheduled publish for 2024-08-15T09:00Z; final copy lock 2024-08-14T16:00Z. Please drop a :thumbsup: when CMS matches doc.

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS copy must match).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved. I'll DM the HubSpot mapping details.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team 2D pushing to CMS and scheduling publish. Closing thread.
